sentences: Polaris is a job-search agent for people looking for LLM and Agent internships in China.
Its one rule: every claim must open to the source it came from.
Job posts and interview write-ups are scattered across many sites, and each must be checked against your own constraints.
General chatbots answer confidently, and often invent the job or the question.
Polaris answers only from stored sources, and says so when it finds nothing.
This is the synthetic demo. The jobs, posts and profile are invented, and the interface is in Chinese.
I ask for Agent internships in Shanghai, at most four days a week, and a comparison of the first job with my profile.
Polaris puts my constraints into the tool arguments, and filters before it retrieves.
The answer lists matching jobs, checks education, papers, attendance and internship length against my memory card, and explains three different dates.
Each job and interview question links to its stored source. A citation that no tool returned would be flagged as unverified.
A follow-up card watches one goal over weeks. The demo script changes the data step by step.
A focus job moves from four days a week to five. Another job is taken down. A new job and a new interview post appear.
Each change is found by comparing snapshots in the local database, and ranked as urgent, digest, or quiet.
The situation report is built from facts that rules compute first. The model only puts them into words.
The competitiveness view asks the three questions a recruiter asks.
Which hard requirements block me, which common skills my card is missing, and what an interviewer will want to know.
When the sample of peers is small, it says so.
Applications are tracked as a funnel. A rejection reason is stored in memory, and later gap analysis uses it.
Polaris drafts follow-up messages, but never sends anything by itself.
Every model call and tool call is traced, with tokens, latency, and cost.
Running the whole loop for real exposed problems no offline test caught.
Post-filtering lost almost all recall. A tight tool budget made the model page through results. And the model invented an interview question, until an orchestration gate stopped it.
Polaris runs on Qwen through Alibaba Cloud Bailian. This entry does not use Nebius Token Factory or an NVIDIA model.
Code and docs are on GitHub, at duoduo-cell slash polaris.
